caption: The video depicts a dark silhouette of a cargo-style ship resting on a choppy deep-blue sea in the lower third of the view. Its hull, central superstructure, and thin masts remain visually steady against a hazy blue-gray sky. Behind and above the vessel, several enormous pale billowing masses of vapor or spray fill most of the upper region. Throughout, the rounded forms on the left and center change only slightly, while a pale column grows upward from the right-hand billow and extends higher toward the top. The ship and waterline stay in position, so the visible change is mainly the continued deformation and ascent of the plumes rather than obvious movement of the vessel. The large billows are already present at the start, and the taller column continues to develop through the end, without a clear beginning or ending.
relations: The ship's hull and superstructure remain steady on the choppy sea while background vapor billows deform and ascend.
A pale column extends upward from the right-hand billow, growing higher toward the top of the frame.
The large billows on the left and center change only slightly, maintaining their presence behind the vessel.
